description: A utility SHALL be implemented in C conforming to the C11 standard for Linux and SHALL use only libc, libssl/libcrypto, and libcurl as external dependencies. The code SHALL compile without warnings using `gcc -O2 -o ferramenta de processamento main.c -lssl -lcrypto -lcurl`. The utility SHALL include a Makefile with an `all` target that compiles the utility and a `clean` target that removes the binary and `.o` files.
name: implementacao_e_build
